animes.name: Animated
animes.description: Mist that breathes, bubbles that rise, petals that fall.

bannieres-animees.name: Animated banners
bannieres-animees.description: An aurora, a tide, embers: your banner comes alive.

contours-animes.name: Animated rings
contours-animes.description: A golden halo, a turning prism, a pulsing ripple.

contours-haussmannien.name: Haussmann ring
contours-haussmannien.description: The Parisian façade: dressed stone, cast iron and keystone.

cadres-haussmannien.name: Haussmann banner frame
cadres-haussmannien.description: The Parisian façade: dressed stone, cast iron and keystone.

contours-arabe.name: Arabesque ring
contours-arabe.description: Alhambra interlace, eight-pointed stars and a lobed arch.

cadres-arabe.name: Arabesque banner frame
cadres-arabe.description: Alhambra interlace, eight-pointed stars and a lobed arch.

contours-ancestral.name: Ancestral African ring
contours-ancestral.description: Earth-painted bogolan and an adinkra sign.

cadres-ancestral.name: Ancestral African banner frame
cadres-ancestral.description: Earth-painted bogolan and an adinkra sign.

contours-technologique.name: African tech ring
contours-technologique.description: Neon Ndebele steps and circuit traces.

cadres-technologique.name: African tech banner frame
cadres-technologique.description: Neon Ndebele steps and circuit traces.

contours-rituel.name: African ritual ring
contours-rituel.description: Fringed raffia, cowries, beads and a wooden mask.

cadres-rituel.name: African ritual banner frame
cadres-rituel.description: Fringed raffia, cowries, beads and a wooden mask.

cadres-illustres.name: Illustrated frames
cadres-illustres.description: Six frames that spill past your avatar: a mask whose eyes turn red, a web and its spider, angel wings, a runic circle, bone claws and demon wings.

cadres-asiatiques.name: Asian frames
cadres-asiatiques.description: Three frames inspired by Asia: a jade dragon coiling around your avatar, drifting silk clouds and swaying paper lanterns.

cadres-africains.name: African frames
cadres-africains.description: Three frames inspired by Africa: an ebony mask whose eyes light up before a savanna sun, rippling woven bands and a rolling bead necklace.

cadres-celtes.name: Celtic frames
cadres-celtes.description: Three frames inspired by Celtic interlace: a knot that fades and redraws itself, a turning triple spiral and an emerald ivy whose leaves quiver.

cadres-nordiques.name: Nordic frames
cadres-nordiques.description: Four frames from the far North: circling ravens, a rippling northern aurora, a carved stone ring that lights up and a carved prow riding the waves.

cadres-egyptiens.name: Egyptian frames
cadres-egyptiens.description: Four frames of gold and lapis: a rising cobra, a scarab opening its wings, a desert sun with a broad collar and Nile lotuses that bloom.

cadres-mayas.name: Maya frames
cadres-mayas.description: Four frames of stone and jade: a jade serpent with a feathered crest, glyph cartouches that light up, a stepped frieze under a rising sun and a jaguar hiding in the jungle.

cadres-indiens.name: Indian frames
cadres-indiens.description: Three frames inspired by Indian motifs: a floral mandala that unfolds, a peacock fanning its tail, a swaying garland of marigolds and jasmine.

cadres-amerindiens.name: Native American frames
cadres-amerindiens.description: Three frames inspired by weaving and beadwork: a woven hoop with swaying stylised feathers, a turning band of beaded diamonds, a stepped sun over mountains and their river.

cadres-australs.name: Southern frames
cadres-australs.description: Three frames inspired by dot painting and the southern sky: twinkling circles of dots, a sea turtle swimming around your avatar, and the shining Southern Cross.

meeshy-signature.name: Meeshy Signature
meeshy-signature.description: Six rings by Meeshy, understated and legible at any size: gold thread, mother-of-pearl beads, eclipse, rosette, starry night and facets.

meeshy-vivants.name: Alive by Meeshy
meeshy-vivants.description: Six animated rings by Meeshy that barely spill past your avatar: an orbit, an aurora halo, a pulse, sparkles, a comet and a swell.

meeshy-fonds.name: Signature wallpapers
meeshy-fonds.description: Six wallpapers by Meeshy that stay quiet under your bubbles, light or dark: silk, dots, fine waves, cane weave, terrazzo and dusk.

meeshy-fonds-vivants.name: Living wallpapers
meeshy-fonds-vivants.description: Four animated wallpapers by Meeshy, gently moving behind your messages: fireflies, aurora veil, soft snow and ripples.

meeshy-bordures.name: Signature borders
meeshy-bordures.description: Six banner frames by Meeshy, kept to the edge so your level and counters stay in view: gold piping, scrolls, pearl string, onyx, marquetry and midnight.

meeshy-bordures-vivantes.name: Living borders
meeshy-bordures-vivantes.description: Four animated banner frames by Meeshy: a glint gliding over gold, shining pearls, a twinkling night and a neon light.

noel-enneige.name: Snowy Christmas
noel-enneige.description: Two animated rings for winter: snowflakes drifting gently around your avatar, and a holly wreath with shining berries.

lumieres-de-noel.name: Christmas lights
lumieres-de-noel.description: Two animated rings that light up for the holidays: a string of bulbs blinking in turn, and a tree-top star that shines.

atelier-du-pere-noel.name: Santa’s workshop
atelier-du-pere-noel.description: Two animated rings straight from the workshop: a red hat with a swinging pompom, and a spinning candy cane tied with a green ribbon.

bannieres-illustrees.name: Illustrated frames
bannieres-illustrees.description: Banner frames to match “Illustrated frames”: Feline mask, Spider web, Angel wings, Runic circle, Bone claws and Demon wings, kept to the edge so your photo stays in view.

bannieres-amerindiennes.description: Banner frames to match “Native American frames”: Feathered woven hoop, Beaded diamonds and Sun over the mountains, kept to the edge so your photo stays in view.
